subject: english
question: Which of the following is not true according to the passage?

options.text: Zucknicks have travelled to 14 countries in 5 years before covid
Americans are keen on resuming travel
Airbnb is the largest travel agency in the U.S

solution:
The correct answer is **"Airbnb is the largest travel agency in the U.S."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage does not mention anything about Airbnb being the largest travel agency in the U.S.
 
• So, the statement "Airbnb is the largest travel agency in the U.S." is not true.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the first sentence of the third paragraph:
 
 
• *"Diana Zucknick and her husband, Paul, visited 14 countries in the five years before COVID-19 caused them to hunker down at their Austin, Texas, home."*
 
 
 
• Option 1 and Option 4 are mentioned in this line and are true.
 
• Let us look at the first sentence of the first paragraph:
 
 
• *"Americans are looking to get out of town after a year of virus-related travel restrictions."*
 
 
 
• *​*Option 2 is true.
